query:
SELECT 
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wow_report_json, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')) IS NULL as is_null,
  LENGTH(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wow_report_json, '$.lifeHistoryPattern'))) as content_length,
  LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(wow_report_json, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')), 300) as preview
FROM analysis_reports ar
WHERE ar.clientId = 1149902;
